kind_why: A combat surf map: small, built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
author: smooth.nl
notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones (gb-maps-1): a minigame surf map. Ten buyzones, and the spawn hall's one teleport wall sends a team to whichever of the leet, target, rocket or halfpipe games the round picked; the rocket game has winners and losers and hammers. No route, no finish. Not published.

round_teleports.note: the spawn hall's teleport wall (`teleporter_<game>_ct/_t`, `teleport_blockfort_*`) is enabled for whichever minigame the round picked; until then each starts disabled. This game runs no round, so imported they were pits round the spawn that sent a player who walked out and back in to the spawn (headless_imported: 'never touches a pit on the way down', 2026-10-11). Dropped, as the map is at the start of a round
